maddeler.e:
ننتقع (form VIII)
# نَنْتَقِعُ (nantaqiʕu) /nan.ta.qi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# نُنْتَقَعُ (nuntaqaʕu) /nun.ta.qa.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# نَنْتَقِعَ (nantaqiʕa) /nan.ta.qi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# نُنْتَقَعَ (nuntaqaʕa) /nun.ta.qa.ʕa/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
